Westwood spent most of its history as the western parish of Dedham and became its own town only in 1897. For decades afterward it stayed largely agricultural—farmhouses along the old roads, a small village at Islington, open land running toward what is now Hale Reservation. Then Route 128 arrived, and the town filled in quickly with the capes, ranches, and colonials that still define most of its streets. That compressed history is why a renovation here starts with the house rather than the wish list. A Westwood home is usually one of two things: an older structure that has been added to many times, or a postwar house that was built soundly and planned for a different way of living. From the owner
In Minnesota, the lower level is not a bonus room. It is where you live for five months. ❄️ From November to March, most families in Maple Grove and the northwest metro spend more waking hours downstairs than anywhere else in the house. And most lower levels were finished as an afterthought — low light, cold floors, one sad ceiling fixture. What transforms one: 🔆 Lighting layers — recessed, cove and lamp light instead of a single overhead 🔥 A real heat source — fireplace or in-floor radiant, so nobody is wearing a coat indoors 🪟 Enlarged egress windows, which bring in far more daylight than people expect 🎬 A dedicated media wall with the wiring designed in rather than strung later 🍸 A wet bar or second kitchenette so nobody climbs the stairs mid-movie 🛏️ A guest suite with a full bath, for the holidays The structural constraints are real — ceiling height, mechanical runs, egress code, moisture management. That is exactly why this belongs with a design-build team rather than a finish carpenter. Forty years of renovating Twin Cities homes. Award-winning. NARI certified. Let's talk about the floor you have been ignoring. 👉️ https://buff.ly/fnq3hpY

From the owner
Ever wonder what happens in the first few days of a remodel? At Prima Construction, the answer is protection. Before a single wall comes down, our team spends two days or more readying your home — and it's one reason those opening days are surprisingly quiet.Our room-by-room system starts at the pre-construction visit, where we plan exactly what your project needs. Then we get to work: Ram Board and 1/8-inch hardboard shield hard-surface floors, while carpet gets layers of Carpet Shield. Stairs receive special attention with extra protection down the center where most feet land, and we inspect it throughout the project.From there, we build the "dirty envelope" with ZipWall dust barriers and zippered doors, line travel paths with rigid foam insulation, and protect railings, furniture, door frames, and appliances. Entry mats and HVAC filter media keep dust where it belongs.It's careful, thorough work — because protecting your home is the foundation of every great remodel.Read our latest blog post to see how we set your project up for success!

From the owner
A San Francisco homeowner once described her bathroom as fine, just dated. Then the old tile came off and the wall behind the tub told a different story, with years of slow moisture hidden behind a clean surface. That is why a bathroom remodeler San Francisco owners can rely on starts with questions, not finishes. Where does the water go, what are the pipes made of and how old is the waterproofing? Answering those first protects the budget and the schedule, because surprises found early cost far less than surprises found after the new tile is set. A good plan accepts that older homes hide things and leaves room for them. If your bathroom has not been touched in decades, assume there is more behind the walls than you can see. Together Home Remodeling helps San Francisco homeowners plan remodels that hold up behind the tile as well as on top of it. #BathroomRemodelerSanFrancisco #SanFranciscoRemodeling #TogetherHomeRemodeling #BathroomRemodel

Adding accessible features not only accommodates aging residents but also people with disabilities or mobility challenges. At Alpine Exteriors & Renovations, the best general contractor in Placerville, we’re committed to creating bathroom spaces that any person is comfortable and safe in. Strategically placed grab bars and handrails near the shower, tub, and toilet are essential for those who have trouble maneuvering around tight spaces. Incorporating these into your bathroom remodel provides support and reduces the risk of falls. Walk-in showers and low-threshold tubs make bathing much more convenient and safe, as they require less mobility than standard shower-tub combos. Non-slip flooring significantly enhances safety, and easy-to-reach fixtures like lever handles and handheld showerheads increase convenience. By thoughtfully incorporating these features, you can create an accessible bathroom space that anyone, no matter their age, abilities, or level of mobility, can enjoy. From the owner
Top 5 Mistakes to Avoid During a Home Remodel: A home remodel is a significant investment, so it’s important to avoid mistakes that can lead to delays, additional costs, or regrets later on. At Ultimate Design & Construction, the best general contractor in Riverside, we specialize in home remodeling and are committed to helping you avoid these five common mistakes: 1. Underestimating your budget: Most remodeling projects come along with a few surprises here and there, so it’s important to create a small buffer between your project’s initial cost and what you can really afford. 2. Skipping permits: Permits ensure your project meets safety standards and local codes. Without them, you could be hit with major fines later on. 3. Changing plans mid-construction: If you change your mind halfway through your project, it could end up costing you thousands. 4. Choosing a contractor based only on price: While cost is important, the lowest bid doesn’t always mean the best value. Choose a Riverside general contractor with a solid track record and proven experience. 5. Prioritizing looks over function: At the end of the day, your space has to work for you, not just look good. Balancing form and function is key to a successful remodel. Avoiding these missteps can save you time, money, and lots of frustration. If you’re planning to remodel your home, contact Ultimate Design & Construction, the most trusted general contractor in Riverside, today!

Most people see a wall of cabinets. We see a complete kitchen support system. Great kitchen design is about more than choosing beautiful cabinetry. It is about creating the right layout, storage, appliance placement, and space planning so the entire kitchen works together. In this kitchen, the appliance pantry wall creates a dedicated zone for food storage, small appliances, baking, meal prep, and everyday kitchen tasks. The refrigerator, pantry storage, and ovens are grouped together to improve organization and make the kitchen easier to use every day. Thoughtful kitchen space planning can make unloading groceries easier, improve meal preparation, and create better flow when multiple family members are using the kitchen at the same time. UNQ Design Studio provides kitchen design, kitchen remodeling, space planning, and virtual kitchen design services for homeowners planning a renovation or new kitchen.
